establishment.name: A Deli Italian Food And Wine

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: OBSERVED THREE CONTAINERS OF MASCARPONE WITH AN EXPIRATION DATE OF 3/5/2026 IN (2)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI: MASCARPONE DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED OVEN CLEANER STORED BESIDE POP IN THE BACK HALLWAY.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: CLEANER RELOCATED.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: OBSERVED UNLABELED CHEMICAL BOTTLE IN THE BATHROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: BOTTLE LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC replaced paper towels

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed variety cheese slices in the 3 dr prep top cooler at 67F using a calibrated thermometer ( cheese was sliced last night)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC disposed of cheese slices

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed a prescription medicine being stored in the 3 door display case and 2 door upright cooler in the rear storage area being stored over food
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Person in charge moved the medicine so it was no longer being stored over food

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: observed in the dry storage area, uncovered trays of pre-made cannoli shells being stored on shelving
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS explained miscellaneous sources of contamination to PIC, PIC agreed to have the cannoli shells covered

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: EHS observed employee health policy not read agreed and signed by employees.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. PIC had employees read agree too and signed employee health policy.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use “HOT SHOT” were observed in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC disposed of residential use pesticides

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS ON SHELF ABOVE RTE FOODS IN AVANTCO 2 DR UR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. - CFM MOVED EGGS TO BOTTOM SHELF

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED CONTAINER OF CHICKEN SALAD IN AVANTCO 2 DR UR WITH NO DATE MARK.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. - CFM STATED CHICKEN SALAD PREPARED 2 DAYS AGO. CFM DATE MARKED CONTAINER.
